content.value: Text, anchors, images, and media are where most course interactions happen. Use clear language for links, set meaningful alt text, and size images appropriately for your layout. Good defaults improve usability while leaving a professional polish.

concepts.name: Anchor element
concepts.description: The HTML element used to create links to pages, resources, sections, or actions.

concepts.name: href
concepts.description: The attribute that specifies the destination of a link.

concepts.name: Image element
concepts.description: The HTML element used to embed an image in a page.

concepts.name: alt text
concepts.description: Text that describes an image for users who cannot see it or when the image fails to load.

concepts.name: Text content
concepts.description: The readable words and characters presented in a document or interface.

concepts.name: Media asset
concepts.description: A file such as an image, audio clip, video, or font used by a web page.
